features.name: Additive multipliers

review:
Crank It Up is a 5x3 disco slot with headphones, microphones and funky shades. Boombox wilds appear on reels 2, 3 and 4.

Three or more golden-record scatters trigger 10, 15 or 20 free spins. Every wild in the bonus marks its spot, and another wild landing there gets an increasing multiplier: 2x, then 3x, 5x and 10x. Multipliers on the same line add together. The RTP is 96%. Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a max win on the page. Marked spots give the bonus a nice sense of build-up.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
